conditions.runtime: Curated JEM JEI catalog only; one server-safe leaf assignment per ItemStack; native JEI recipes and separate standard JEI entry remain.

change.summary: Replace the cross-category search with one bottom search in the selected category and assign reviewed materials, glass, lights, containers and display pieces to their semantic leaves.

modifiers.before: Global category search and category search both visible.
modifiers.after: One search field at the bottom filters the active category only; global search is removed.

modifiers.before: Broad furniture/decor and building heuristics placed materials, glass, light sources, storage and display objects in inappropriate leaves.
modifiers.after: Materials include ordinary placeable construction blocks, bricks, slabs, stairs, cushion block variants and snow/sandstone after functional exceptions; separate Glass and Light leaves. Tom's Storage, Sophisticated Backpacks/Storage, MobHome and the Shipping Box are containers; Casual Swing, Shutter Up, Chimes, Secret Doors, Beachparty displays, antler stands, stakes, skulls and trophies are decor; dolls are wearable. Kaleidoscope, Bakery and Herbal Brews items and cooking stations are food; Infinity Buttons are Create/Redstone, XtraArrows are weapons, and ores, dynamite, resin, shells, buckets and resource stones are excluded from construction.
